hero.subtitle: A considered starter for developers who value craft. {{count}} components, enterprise patterns, and zero compromise — wired together so you can ship on day one.

features.title: Everything wired, nothing in your way.

componentLibrary.title: Component Library
componentLibrary.desc: Radix primitives on one vocabulary — variant × tone × size, typed slots, dark mode by tokens.

formSystem.title: Form System
formSystem.desc: {{count}} fields with one contract: label, description, inline errors, React Hook Form + Zod.

dataTables.title: Data Tables
dataTables.desc: Filters, sorting, pinning and pagination on TanStack Table, with numeric columns that read right in RTL.

internationalization.title: Internationalization
internationalization.desc: English and Arabic with full RTL; digits stay Western, data stays readable.

errorMonitoring.title: Error Monitoring
errorMonitoring.desc: Boundaries and reporting wired in from the start.

showcase.title: See exactly what you get.
showcase.desc: {{count}} MDX pages with live previews, code and usage notes for every component.

cli.title: Generate, don't write.
cli.desc: A 7-step pipeline fetches your OpenAPI spec, parses schemas, generates fully-typed TypeScript DTOs, formats with Prettier, and writes to disk. One command replaces hours of manual typing.

architecture.title: Organized by design.
architecture.desc: 15 path aliases keep imports clean and refactoring painless. Every folder has a purpose, every alias has a convention. No guessing where things live.

specimen.label: Component specimens
specimen.description: A live sample of the kit: a day calendar with tinted events and the current-time line, a time field and an email field with an inline error, status tags, an invoice table with a selected row, a success toast and a delete confirmation.
